title: marketplace
description: Discover, quote & invoke RocketCore x402-paid cyber/market intelligence products.
summary: Discover, quote & invoke RocketCore x402-paid cyber/market intelligence products.
offersHint: Discover, quote & invoke RocketCore x402-paid cyber/market intelligence products. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://intel.rocket-core.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_rocketcore_products
toolsPreview.description: List all RocketCore Intel Marketplace products with status, price, and endpoint. Free, read-only.

toolsPreview.name: search_rocketcore_products
toolsPreview.description: Task-focused search over RocketCore products (deterministic weighted keyword + natural-language match, no LLM). Free.

toolsPreview.name: inspect_rocketcore_product
toolsPreview.description: Return the full public manifest for one product: schemas, provenance, freshness, limitations, pricing, payment terms. Free.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_rocketcore_product
toolsPreview.description: Recommend the best-matching LIVE products for a described task, with an explanation of why each matched. Deterministic, no LLM. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_rocketcore_quote
toolsPreview.description: Return the exact price and x402 payment terms (amount, atomic_amount, currency, network, asset, pay_to, endpoint) for a product. Free; quoting does not pay.

toolsPreview.name: invoke_rocketcore_product
toolsPreview.description: Return everything needed for the AGENT to invoke a paid product over x402. This server NEVER pays: it returns the endpoint + x402 payment-required terms; the agent pays with its own wallet and receives data + a settlement receipt in the same 200 response.

toolsPreview.name: check_rocketcore_delivery
toolsPreview.description: Explain/verify delivery for an x402 purchase. RocketCore delivery is ATOMIC with payment (data + receipt returned in the same 200 response), so there is no async delivery to poll. Optionally echoes back a caller-supplied receipt reference for their own records. Never exposes other parties' settlement records.

toolsPreview.name: get_rocketcore_marketplace_status
toolsPreview.description: Return marketplace summary: product counts, live count, categories, supported payment protocols/networks/currencies, and honest per-market publication status. Free.
